Penggantian Jadual Kedua

2. Perintah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan Jadual Kedua dengan jadual

yang berikut:

"JADUAL KEDUA

[Perenggan 3]

KENDERAAN YANG DIKECUALIKAN

(a) Kenderaan yang membawa Seri Paduka Baginda Yang di-Pertuan Agong atau

Raja Permaisuri Agong, Raja-Raja atau Permaisuri-Permaisuri Baginda,

Yang di-Pertua Negeri bagi Negeri-Negeri Melaka, Pulau Pinang, Sabah dan Sarawak

atau isteri-isteri mereka, Dato'-Dato' Undang Negeri Sembilan atau Tengku Besar

Tampin atau isteri-isteri mereka, Tengku Mahkota atau Raja Muda mana-mana

Negeri atau isteri-isteri mereka, Raja Di-Hilir Perak atau isterinya, atau mana-mana

pembesar asing yang datang melawat.

(b) Mana-mana kenderaan Kerajaan yang membawa Perdana Menteri,

Timbalan Perdana Menteri, Menteri dan Timbalan Menteri.

(c) Mana-mana kenderaan Kerajaan yang membawa Menteri Besar Negeri Kelantan,

Timbalan Menteri Besar Negeri Kelantan dan Majlis Mesyuarat Kerajaan

Negeri Kelantan.

(d) Semua kenderaan tentera kepunyaan Kerajaan atau mana-mana angkatan pelawat

sebagaimana yang ditakrifkan dalam Akta Angkatan Pelawat 1960

[Akta 432].

(e) Semua kenderaan Kerajaan yang digunakan semata-mata bagi tugas ambulans,

melawan kebakaran atau tugas polis, dan kenderaan bukan Kerajaan yang

digunakan semata-mata bagi tugas ambulans.

(f) Mana-mana kenderaan Kerajaan yang digunakan bagi tugas rasmi Kerajaan.".

Dibuat 18 Disember 2024

[KKR.PUU.110.-1/7/43; PN(PU2)86/JLD.29]

Dengan Titah Perintah

 TAN SRI SHAMSUL AZRI BIN ABU BAKAR

 Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Fi 1951]

FEES ACT 1951

FEES (PENGKALAN KUBOR FERRY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209],

the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (Pengkalan Kubor Ferry)

(Amendement) Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2024.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. Fee (Pengkalan Kubor Ferry) Order 1990 [P.U. (A) 84/1990], which is referred to

as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 2]

(1)

Passengers/Categories of Vehicle

(2)

Fee Payable

(RM)

1. Passengers (aged 13 and above) 1.00

2. Motorcycle (with rider) 2.00

3. Wheelbarrow 2.00

4. Car (with driver) 8.00

5. Lorry (with driver and conductor)

(i) 4 tyres 8.00

(ii) 6 tyres 10.00

(iii) 10 tyres 13.00

6. Bus (with driver and conductor) 13.00

7. Van (with driver) 8.00

8. Cargo < 100 kg 2.00

9. Cargo 100 kg–1000 kg 3.00

10. Cargo > 1000 kg 8.00 ".

Substitution of Second Schedule

2. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the Second Schedule

the following schedule:

"SECOND SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 3]

EXEMPTED VEHICLES

(a) Vehicles carrying Their Majesties the Yang di-Pertuan Agong or

the Raja Permaisuri Agong, Their Highnesses the Rulers or their consorts,

the Yang di-Pertua Negeri of the States of Malacca, Penang, Sabah and Sarawak or

their wives, Dato'-Dato' Undang Negeri Sembilan or the Tengku Besar Tampin or

their wives, the Tengku Mahkota or the Raja Muda of any State or their wives,

the Raja Di-Hilir of Perak or his wife, or any visiting foreign dignitary.

(b) Any Government vehicle carrying the Prime Minister, Deputy Prime Minister,

Ministers and Deputy Ministers.

(c) Any Government vehicle carrying Menteri Besar of the State of Kelantan,

Deputy Menteri Besar of the State of Kelantan and State Executive

Council of Kelantan.

(d) All military vehicles belonging to the Government or any visiting force as defined

in the Visiting Forces Act 1960 [Act 432].

(e) All Government vehicles used solely for ambulance, fire-fighting or police duties,

and non-Government vehicles used solely for ambulance duty.

(f) Any Government vehicle used for official Government duties.".

Made 18 December 2024

[KKR.PUU.110.-1/7/43 ; PN(PU2)86/JLD.29]

By Command

 TAN SRI SHAMSUL AZRI BIN ABU BAKAR

 Secretary to the Cabinet

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat pursuant to section 4 of the Fee Act 1951]
